Plan 010 retains the broader keypress, IME, and platform interaction matrix.

Plan 010 retains the broader target, pointer-owner, and browser wheel matrix.

The synchronous DOM shell and paused write queue now match textarea blur reporting inside pre-ready write callbacks and after readiness. Plan 010 retains the complete cross-browser focus and accessibility matrix.

Stable fail-loud placeholder only. Plan 009 must provide native normal/alternate buffer identity, rows, cells, and change events through the C ABI; visible renderer rows or facade-side storage cannot implement this contract.

Accepted divergence: released xterm 6.0 preserves the cursor row, can true-no-op at cursor origin, keeps selections without notifying, and leaves logically discarded CircularList slots observable. This facade deliberately does none of those things. From VT ground it inserts Ghostty's upstream `CSI 22 J + CSI 3 J + CUP` visual-clear sequence, clears the native selection, removes active contents and scrollback, moves the cursor to VT home under the current origin/margins, and requests a redraw. A mid-sequence parser makes `clear()` throw synchronously before any mutation. Differential evidence records blank target rows and one selection notification where released xterm retains content and raw selection coordinates. No fork, row cache, detached-row graveyard, or shadow terminal is maintained. The row remains partial and must not be marked compatible.

Native clearing exists, but released xterm emits selection-change notifications according to its browser SelectionService lifecycle even when no native selection changes. Exact event ordering and raw-coordinate behavior require the Plan 009 native selection seam.

Native atlas clearing exists, but the facade cannot reproduce released xterm's exact full-redraw event range until renderer frames expose rows damaged in the current frame separately from the full cached snapshot.
Browser differential evidence covers valid typed dimensions, init-only setters, resize values, and deduplicated events; invalid and boundary cases remain uncertified.

Browser differential evidence covers valid dimensions and init-only option observables. Asynchronous native creation is Ghostty-specific: failure rejects the diagnostic ghosttyReady promise, abandons queued callbacks, and leaves write/disposal rows partial. Invalid dimension normalization and the full option/default matrix remain uncertified.

Browser evidence covers core teardown before reverse-order addon disposal, propagation of the first addon failure, and the post-ready scheduled-write divergence. Any write not consumed by the native parser when disposal begins is abandoned without its callback or onWriteParsed; released xterm keeps its JavaScript write task alive and invokes the pending callbacks after disposal. Pre-ready disposal also cancels attachment and disposes any late native resolution. This accepted Plan 015 lifecycle divergence remains partial.

Normal pre-open, synchronous-open, and post-open-disposal identities match browser evidence. The intentional dispose-before-first-open divergence leaves this undefined instead of reproducing released xterm's half-created connected DOM.

The synchronous DOM shell and paused write queue now match textarea focus reporting inside pre-ready write callbacks and after readiness. Plan 010 retains the complete cross-browser focus and accessibility matrix.
